in_marathi.name: Nantu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nara-Simha, the man-lion form of Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nantu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nantu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' meaning man and 'Simha' meaning lion. This name represents the divine form of Lord Vishnu known as Nara-Simha, who is a man with a lion's head. The name Nantu signifies bravery, power, and strength, and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
